_comment: Tickers to collect Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) for -- the SaaS subset of advisor_universe.json, not the whole universe, for the same reason pipeline/config/operating_kpi_universe.json's retail/restaurant list is scoped the way it is: fetching every universe ticker's earnings-release exhibit to look for phrasing only recurring-revenue software companies use would spend most of the SEC rate-limit budget on names that were always going to return 'not_found'. Derived once from public/data/advisor.json's screen_universe sector/industry classification (2026-08-27 snapshot) for the Yahoo industries: Software - Application and Software - Infrastructure. Not every ticker below is a 'pure' ARR-reporting SaaS company -- some are legacy enterprise software that does not use ARR/NRR phrasing, and a few (e.g. UBER, LYFT) are marketplaces classified into these industries that will not use this phrasing at all; those are expected to resolve 'not_found' rather than being pre-filtered out, since a wrong guess about who reports ARR is exactly the kind of judgment call this collector should not be making. A company's sector/industry classification changes rarely enough that this list does not need to be regenerated every run; regenerate by re-filtering a fresh screen_universe snapshot on the same industry set if it drifts.
